content.value: Define complex variable and function of complex variable. What is Argand diagram? 12 Describe geometrically the region which the inequality $1 < | z + i | \leq 2$ represents in the Argand’s diagram.

<sup>(b)</sup> Prove that lg $\begin{array} { r } { \left( \frac { x + i y } { x - i y } \right) = 2 i \tan ^ { - 1 } \frac { y } { x } } \end{array}$ and hence evaluate cos[i log $\textstyle { \left( { \frac { x + i y } { x - i y } } \right) } ]$

<sup>(c)</sup> Is the function $\textstyle u = { \frac { x - y } { x ^ { 2 } + y ^ { 2 } } }$ harmonic? If so find the corresponding analytic function f(z) 13 such that $\mathbf { f } ( \mathbf { z } ) = \mathbf { u } + \mathbf { i v } .$
